addPota: **Add your POTA activation too** — this event has no exchange of its own. It is scored from the Florida state park you activate and the parks you work, as POTA references.
period: **Period:** {{period}}, 8 am to 8 pm EDT each day
scoring: **Score:** 1 point per SSB or digital QSO and 2 per CW QSO, park by park, plus 100 for each park with 10 QSOs. A station counts once per band and mode from each park you activate; 160, 80, 40, 20, 15, 10 and 6 m only.
submit: **Submit** one ADIF per park at [fspota.org](https://fspota.org/logging/) within 14 days. The first-time activator and youth operator bonuses are claimed on that form.
